title: DEBT99: the empty-slot check decodes every uncached photo at full size
note: The empty-slot check decodes each photograph that has no cached answer, at full size, before the quote is printed. `cli/cmd_identify.run` calls the check in `identify/match.py` (`empty_slot`) on each of them. The check runs before the dry-run quote can skip it, so a dry run pays for the whole pass. On 2,500 new cards the pass takes 100 to 300 s.
